bio.p2: I am <1>Caio Rafael de Oliveira</1>, a Full Stack developer driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and a genuine desire to create things that make sense for people. I believe technology is, above all, a tool to <2>solve real problems</2>, connect people, and open paths.
bio.p3: I have a strong passion for <1>entrepreneurship</1>, taking ideas off paper and transforming them into products and solutions with purpose. I like to think beyond code: understanding contexts, needs, and impacts. That's what makes a project alive and relevant.
bio.p4: Along the way, I actively participated in academic and institutional projects that taught me about <1>leadership, collaboration, and responsibility</1>, always seeking to grow and help others grow with me.

indra-minsait.title: Indra Minsait
indra-minsait.shortDescription: Software Analyst work on judicial and government systems for the Court of Justice of Paraíba.
indra-minsait.longDescription:
# Indra Minsait

Software Analyst work on judicial and government systems connected to the Court of Justice of Paraíba, a Brazilian state court institution.

## Challenge
Maintain, modernize, and evolve large-scale institutional applications, including legacy Java systems, service integrations, and internal workflows that support public-sector operations.

## Solution
Development and maintenance of features with Java and Angular, integration with internal and external services, reliability improvements, and collaboration through engineering routines such as code review, debugging, TDD, and agile methodologies.
responsibilities: Maintenance and modernization of legacy Java applications
Development of new features with Java and Angular
Integration with internal and external services
Support for system reliability and internal workflow improvements
Participation in debugging, TDD, code reviews, and agile routines
results: Continuous evolution of large-scale institutional systems
Stronger technical support for judicial and government applications
Collaboration in engineering processes focused on quality and maintainability

connecta-hub.title: Connecta Hub
connecta-hub.shortDescription: Gamified internal management platform for organizing projects, teams, and deliveries in the academic community of UFPB's Informatics Center.
connecta-hub.longDescription:
# Connecta Hub

Connecta Hub is a tool created to support the academic community of UFPB's Informatics Center in the internal management of university projects.

## Challenge
Academic projects often involve many people, deadlines, demands, and responsibilities spread across conversations, spreadsheets, and loose documents. This makes it harder to track deliveries, see progress, and keep participants engaged.

## Solution
A centralized and gamified platform to organize projects, track activities, clarify internal workflows, and turn member participation into a more visual, collaborative, and motivating experience.
responsibilities: Development of the internal management platform
Creation of workflows for tracking academic projects
Application of gamification elements to engage the community
Responsive interface built around university routines
results: Centralized project control in a single environment
Greater clarity around activities, responsibilities, and team progress
More engaging experience for members of the academic community

Digital platform developed for the most accessible pet health plan in Brazil, part of the Grupo Cartão de Todos ecosystem.

leadsim.title: LeadSim
leadsim.shortDescription: SaaS CRM and lead management platform centralizing clients, proposals, contracts, finance, and marketing automation in one place.
leadsim.longDescription:
# LeadSim

Complete lead management and CRM system developed to simplify and centralize all commercial operations for companies and franchises.

## Challenge
Companies face the chaos of multiple spreadsheets and disconnected systems to manage CRM, finance, and automation, resulting in lost leads and low productivity.

## Solution
Integrated platform that unifies:
- Lead control and qualification
- Contract and proposal generation
- Financial management
- Marketing automation and follow-ups
- Centralized registrations and opportunities
results: Complete centralization of commercial operations
Elimination of multiple spreadsheets and systems
Intelligent lead nurturing automation

rfcc-colab.title: RFCC-COLAB
rfcc-colab.shortDescription: Volunteer platform for the Female Network Fighting Cancer focused on increasing donations, e-commerce, and recurring subscriptions.
rfcc-colab.longDescription:
# RFCC-COLAB

Platform developed voluntarily for the Female Network Fighting Cancer aiming to increase fundraising and expand the institution's reach.

## Challenge
The institution faced difficulties managing donations and maintaining a constant flow of fundraising to sustain its support projects for cancer patients.

## Solution
Development of an integrated platform with three main pillars:
- Online donation system with multiple payment methods
- E-commerce for selling institutional products
- Recurring subscription program for monthly donors
results: Increased monthly collection via recurring subscriptions
Significant growth in donor base with new payment methods
New revenue source with digital commerce within the platform

colab-ufpb.title: Núcleo Colab UFPB
colab-ufpb.shortDescription: Institutional platform for UFPB's Innovation and Entrepreneurship Core, connecting startups to the university incubation ecosystem.
colab-ufpb.longDescription:
# Núcleo Colab UFPB

Institutional portal developed for the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Core of the Federal University of Paraíba, connecting startups, researchers, and the market.

## Challenge
The core needed a professional digital presence to promote its incubation programs, attract new entrepreneurs, and connect the academic community to the innovation ecosystem.

## Solution
Development of a modern platform presenting:
- Incubation and pre-incubation programs
- Portfolio of incubated startups
- Information on mentorship and available resources
- Registration forms for new projects
results: Professional digital presence for the core
Greater visibility for the incubation program
Easy application for new entrepreneurs
